note: ADR 1148 (round 2, N1): an Attr node reached by an XPath call whose identifiers are written with an escape (`ev\u0061luate`, `singleNodeV\u0061lue`) is retyped (`value = "text"`); the retyped, dirty, focused control is removed by an ancestor's textContent write inside Grab's owned body and delivers `change` there. Chrome warns REACTIVE_WRITE_IN_OWNED_SCOPE and STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at the handler's setter and read; the checker stays uncertifiable (the proof is withdrawn).
